about_the_game:
A fast-paced multiplayer shooter where your bullets aren’t just weapons—it’s your only way to move. Use the recoil from your guns to fight, maneuver, and survive in chaotic 2D vertical arenas.

Fire at Me introduces new mechanics to the realm of normal shooters. Forget jumping—here, your only way to move around is through the explosive power of your guns. Every shot launches you across the map, turning recoil into your greatest weapon and your only mobility.

Offense becomes your best defense. Movement is a precise shot. And survival? Improvise. Can you become a master of maneuvers amidst the rapid-fire action?

Key Features

Recoil as Movement – No jump button. Your only method of moving is from the recoil of your weapons–every shot counts.

Multiplayer Mayhem – Compete with friends and rivals in fast-paced online matches.

Dynamic Arenas – Maps with cool design and obstacles to maneuver around while trying to shoot down your opponents.

Unconventional Arsenal – There are many unique weapons – Not just Guns – that all have their own special mechanic.

High Skill Ceiling – Master the physics of recoil and discover new movement tricks to outplay your opponents.
